basics.name: Kartikey Pandey
basics.label: Founder, Karts
basics.summary: Software engineer and full-stack developer building scalable systems, cloud-native apps, and AI-driven solutions. Founder, Karts: Karts is the IDE and coding servers for startups, built for enterprise compliance and reliability without losing startup speed. Member of Technical Staff at Cara (June 2026 to present). Previously Founding Engineer at Raya Health (HF0 W26, February to May 2026). 12x hackathon winner across ML, computer vision, and full-stack. At Intel, built ML pipelines that cut deployment time 33%. On the Lunar Autonomy Challenge team (NASA-affiliated, run by JHU APL), worked on autonomous robotics with SLAM and AI frameworks. At Snap's Spectacles Accelerator, secured $25,000+ for AR/AI development. Built EyeSnap, a diabetic retinopathy detection prototype that won Best Use of MATLAB at HackHarvard 2023. Founder/President of Penn State's Collegiate Hackathon Team (#185 to #74 nationally) and President of GDSC @ Penn State (200+ students).
